description: This script automates an Android device testing process, including bootloader operations, flashing firmware images, monitoring battery status, and executing monkey tests to simulate user interaction. It manages device states via adb and fastboot commands, performs flashing of bootloader, radio, system, and userdata partitions, and runs multiple test cycles with optional configurations.

methods.name: log_print
methods.description: Prints a timestamped message to the console.

methods.name: wait_for_battery
methods.description: Waits until the device's battery level is above a certain threshold, or waits for it to charge if low.

methods.name: fastboot_wait_for_device
methods.description: Polls for device availability in fastboot mode with a timeout.

methods.name: reboot_into_fastboot_from_adb
methods.description: Reboots the device into fastboot mode from adb.

methods.name: reboot_into_fastboot_from_fastboot
methods.description: Reboots the device into fastboot mode from fastboot.

methods.name: reboot_into_adb_from_fastboot
methods.description: Reboots the device into adb mode from fastboot.

methods.name: wait_for_boot_complete
methods.description: Waits until the device has finished booting.

methods.name: fastboot_command
methods.description: Wrapper to send commands via fastboot.

methods.name: flash_partition
methods.description: Flashes a specific partition with a given image.

methods.name: adb_command
methods.description: Wrapper to send commands via adb.

methods.name: flash_bootloader_image
methods.description: Flashes the bootloader image onto the device.

methods.name: flash_radio_image
methods.description: Flashes the radio image onto the device.

methods.name: flash_system_image
methods.description: Flashes the system image onto the device.

methods.name: flash_device
methods.description: Performs erasing cache, flashing userdata, bootloader, radio, system images, and reboots the device.

methods.name: set_product_type
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the product type of the device.
